name: Mentionlytics
description: Mentionlytics lets marketing, PR, and social media teams explore and analyze social media listening data, previously unavailable on Claude. Uncover the people, channels, and sources driving discussion across social media, web, reviews, and other monitored media. Allow Claude to deeply analyze your brand and your competitors mentions on Social Media to discover patterns and meaningful conclusions.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Mentionlytics to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Mentionlytics to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.mentionlytics.com/v1. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Mentionlytics MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Mentionlytics provides these MCP tools: get_account_info, get_aggregations, get_keywords, get_mentioners, get_mentions, get_mentions_per_day, get_topics, get_tracker_groups, get_trackers, and semantic_search.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Mentionlytics?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Mentionlytics in marketing-seo on the Manufact MCP catalog include Buzzfy, Airefs AI Visibility, TalkGenAI, RankControl, and attentive-mcp-server.
Mentionlytics requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Mentionlytics is developed by Mentionlytics. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
